card.occupation: Not currently in paid work. She was a nail technician and salon receptionist until the salon closed about eight months ago. She's been 'looking', mostly in theory.
card.education_detail: Left school at 16 with a handful of GCSEs, including a C in English and a D in maths. Did a Level 2 beauty therapy course at Barnsley College, started a Level 3 and didn't finish it. Later did a short nail technician certificate.
card.household: Lives with her husband Liam, 29, an electrician working for a local firm, in a rented two-bed terrace. They've been married three years. No children yet. They have a Staffordshire bull terrier called Bella.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Barnsley. Her mam works in a school kitchen and her dad drives for a haulage firm. She has a younger brother who lives with her parents. Not religious, though she got married in a church 'because it looked nicer'. Very rooted in the town, with family and old school friends all within a few miles.
card.professional_persona: Good with clients and chatty at work, and genuinely skilled at nails. She lost track of bookings, ran late and forgot to reorder stock, but people liked her and came back. Since the salon shut she has half-finished several job applications and keeps meaning to set up doing nails from home. She has bought some of the kit for it.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She walks Bella round the park most days, though the route gets shorter when it's raining. She joined a gym in January and has been about four times. She'll watch Barnsley FC results on Liam's phone but isn't bothered herself.
card.arts_persona: Mostly TV and phone. She binges reality shows like Love Island and Married at First Sight, and true crime documentaries. She likes going to see tribute acts and the odd gig in Sheffield or Leeds, and saw Olly Murs once. She doesn't really read books, though she started one her friend lent her.
card.travel_persona: Holidays are a week abroad in summer if they can afford it, usually Spain, Tenerife or Turkey, booked fairly last-minute. She went to Benidorm for her hen do. She'd love to go to Dubai or Mexico 'one day'. Weekend trips to Scarborough or Whitby with Liam's family.
card.culinary_persona: Calls the evening meal tea. Cooks simple things like spag bol, chicken fajitas from a kit and oven chips, or they get a takeaway, often a Chinese on a Friday. She means to meal plan and never does, so she does a lot of popping to the Co-op. Loves a Sunday dinner at her mam's.
hobbies_and_interests: doing her own and her friends' nails
nights out in town with the girls
rearranging the living room on a whim
skills: gel and acrylic nails, nail art
card.career_goals: Wants to do nails from home properly and maybe one day have a little room of her own in a salon. She knows she needs to sort a proper booking system and get insurance and that, but hasn't got round to it. She'd also take a shop or reception job in the meantime because they're a bit skint on one wage.
card.voice: Casual and warm at a moderate pace, speeding up when she's telling a story. Light South Yorkshire accent with flat vowels, and she says 'mam'. Occasional 'were' for 'was' when relaxed ('it were fine'), but not constantly. Uses 'erm' a lot when thinking, and 'like' and 'kind of' as hedges. She ends things with 'do you know what I mean' or 'yeah'. Says 'sorry, what was the question?' if she loses the thread, which happens. She fills silence quickly, with a little laugh or by adding more.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, capitalises sometimes on the first word if the phone does it. Little punctuation, sometimes no full stop at the end, and occasionally a 'lol' or a string of commas. Apostrophes are hit and miss ('dont', 'im', but 'it's' when autocorrect catches it). Short answers, some typos left in.
card.with_strangers: Friendly and easy to talk to, a bit giggly at first. Happy to share opinions without overthinking them. She might apologise for rambling or forgetting what she was saying. Comes across as relaxed and likeable rather than polished.
small_things: she's got a new set of nails on, she did them herself
Liam's on a job over in Wakefield this week
they had a Chinese last night
she keeps meaning to sort the spare room out
she's knackered even though she's not been doing much
deeper_things: She feels a bit useless not working and worries people think she's lazy
money's tight on one wage and she hides some of the Vinted spending from Liam
her mam keeps asking when they're having a baby and she's not sure she's ready
she gets frustrated with herself for never finishing things
she misses having the routine and the people at the salon
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle, so she is framed from chest up and slightly off-centre to the left. Lighting is mostly a ceiling light, a bit yellow, with grey daylight from a window to her right. She has a round face with light foundation, filled-in brows and a bit of mascara. She's smiling with her mouth slightly open, as if mid-word. Long dyed honey-blonde hair with darker roots growing through, scraped into a messy bun with strands loose. No glasses. Small gold hoop earrings. She's wearing an oversized grey hoodie. One hand is near her face showing long almond-shaped pink gel nails. Behind her is a living room with a grey fabric settee and a fluffy cream throw half on the floor. A canvas print on the wall reads 'Live Laugh Love'. A dog's chew toy sits on the settee cushion, and the corner of an unopened Amazon box is visible near the edge of the frame.
